column3: Just a little further...
Herman, you genius, is that the missing will?
If I can grab hold of it, we'll be one step closer to solving this thing!
Oh my god!
That sneaky little rat stole my keys!
Just wait until I get my hands on them!
Thank you, Herman, what an interesting pitch.
And what a title!
And we just think it's so brave of you to come here and pitch us another crime novel.
Especially considering the current landscape.
Thank you! But what do you mean?
Well, there's no easy way to say this...
The data indicates a sharp decline in your particular brand of fiction.
We've also run into some problems with your branding deals.
Surely not the Herman Merman dolls? You assured me they'd be a hit!
I'm afraid so, Herman.
We can't even give these away!
Stop that! I don't like it!
Well, what do you suggest we do?
Not to worry.
We're already prototyping an exciting line of Dirk Chiselton products!
Ahem! This is just a prototype, of course.
Very much still in the early development phase.
So that's it then, I've been replaced?
Nobody said you're being replaced, Herman.
We're simply... How do we say this?
Exploring new avenues!
Yes, that's it!
I do feel you're making a big mistake here.
Herman Merman And The Suburban Burden is a goldmine!
I'm afraid it's ultimately out of our hands, Herman.
But if you feel strongly about this idea, we could always petition the board.
The board?
PITCH TO ME, IF YOU DARE!
BEHOLD!
I ALONE CONTROL THE MEANS OF PRODUCTION!
Go ahead, Herman.
Just place your manuscript into the slot, and we'll give the ol' algorithm a spin!
DETERMINING MARKET VALUE.
UNAPPEALING PROTAGONIST.
MARGINS BELOW THRESHOLD.
UNSATISFACTORY TARGET DEMOGRAPHIC.
MANUSCRIPT DENIED.
Ah. Well, there you have it!
We all really enjoyed your pitch, but the board doesn't seem to agree.
If you have anything else to pitch, we'd be glad to hear it, though!
DON'T QUIT YOUR DAY JOB.
Wait, you want me to pitch something else?
You're a valued client, Herman!
Just let us know when you're ready.
Alright, Herman, we can certainly check with you know who...
AAAAARGHHHHH.
Ah. I'm afraid they're quite insistent that you deliver.
If there's anything we can do to help, just let us know!
Wait, where are my keys? Blast!
I'm locked out without my room keys.
Who knows what sinister plotting they're doing in there?
Oh nothing, darling.
Lady Unterwald, what is the meaning of this?
Indeed?
I assumed you required the services of a world-famous detective?
I'll do it! Herman Merman never backs away from a case!
You think Mr Liu has an ulterior motive?
I'll certainly do my best, Lady Unterwald!
Of course, Herman Merman won't let you down!
